info.title: Phonely API
info.description: API for Phonely services including agent management and call summaries

post.description: Retrieve agent information based on the provided user ID and agent ID
Create a duplicate of an existing agent for the specified user
Retrieve information for all agents associated with the user

get.description: Retrieve information for all organizations associated with the user

post.description: Retrieve information for a specific call

get.description: Retrieves a list of calls for a specific agent with comprehensive filtering and pagination options

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: The ID of the agent whose calls you want to retrieve

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by call status (can specify multiple values)

parameters.name: sentiment
parameters.description: Filter by sentiment (can specify multiple values)

parameters.name: call_type
parameters.description: Filter by call type (can specify multiple values)

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Filter by call outcome (can specify multiple values)

parameters.name: ended_reason
parameters.description: Filter by call ended reason (can specify multiple values)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Filter by call mode (can specify multiple values)

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Filter calls after this date (ISO 8601 datetime format)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Filter calls before this date (ISO 8601 datetime format)

400.description: Agent ID is missing or invalid

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - You do not have access to this agent

post.description: Import a Twilio phone number to an agent

get.description: Get a list of all available voices for your agent

post.description: Update the setup for a specific agent

success.description: Indicates if the update was successful

get.description: Retrieves the list of blocked phone numbers for a specific agent

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: The ID of the agent whose block list you want to retrieve

post.summary: Add phone numbers to block list
post.description: Adds phone numbers to an agent's block list

400.description: Invalid request body or numbers parameter

delete.summary: Remove phone numbers from block list
delete.description: Removes phone numbers from an agent's block list

400.description: Invalid request body or numbers parameter

post.summary: Report an issue with a call
post.description: Submit an error report for a specific call with feedback and suggestions

success.description: Indicates if the report was submitted successfully

patch.description: Set post call outcome fields for a call identified by either call ID or phone number.

parameters.name: callIdOrPhone
parameters.description: The ID of the call or the E.164 phone number

parameters.name: preference
parameters.description: first: first time that someone called in, last: latest call from someone

get.description: Retrieve all documents associated with a specific agent

post.description: Upload documents to an agent's knowledge base. Maximum 10 files, each under 10MB. Supports PDF, DOCX, and TXT files.

400.description: Invalid request or file validation error

delete.description: Delete a document from an agent's knowledge base

get.description: Retrieve all websites associated with a specific agent's knowledge base

post.summary: Add websites to agent knowledge base
post.description: Crawl and add websites to an agent's knowledge base. Supports customizable crawling parameters including depth limit, URL filtering, and page limits.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (max 10)

excludePaths.description: Array of URL paths to exclude from crawling

includePaths.description: Array of URL paths to include in crawling (if specified, only these paths will be crawled)

delete.summary: Delete website from agent knowledge base
delete.description: Remove a specific website from an agent's knowledge base

post.summary: Generate an agent from a prompt
post.description: Asynchronously create an inbound agent and its first flow from a natural-language prompt. Repeating the same request with the same idempotency key returns the existing generation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this logical generation request. Maximum 128 characters.

200.description: The idempotent request has reached a terminal status

Location.description: Relative URL for checking generation status

202.description: The generation is queued or in progress

Location.description: Relative URL for checking generation status

403.description: The user cannot create agents in the organization

409.description: The idempotency key was used for different request data

500.description: Agent generation could not be started

get.description: Return the current status of a prompt-based agent generation owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: generationId
parameters.description: Generation identifier returned by the create request

404.description: Generation not found or not owned by the authenticated user

500.description: Generation status could not be loaded

custom_call_outcome.description: The outcome label (e.g., Sold, No Sale)

custom_call_outcome_value.description: The monetary value associated with the outcome

custom_call_metadata.description: Additional custom metadata for the call

uid.description: User ID (can be retrieved from the user settings page)

agentId.description: Agent ID (can be retrieved from the agent settings page)

callId.description: Call ID (can be retrieved from the call history page)

agentName.description: Name of the agent handling the call

agentId.description: ID of the agent that handled the call

businessPhoneNumber.description: Business phone number used for the call

messages.description: Structured call messages; currently the same data as transcript

ai_success.description: Whether the AI completed the call successfully

topic.description: Topic or topic labels assigned to the call

keyPoints.description: Key points identified during the call

mentionedEmail.description: Email address mentioned during the call

callerName.description: Caller name extracted from the call

unansweredQuestions.description: List of questions that were not answered during the call

actionItems.description: List of action items identified during the call

recordingUrl.description: URL to access the call recording

transcriptText.description: Text transcript containing user and assistant messages

callStartedDateString.description: Call start formatted in the agent's timezone

callEndedDateString.description: Call end formatted in the agent's timezone

duration.description: Duration of the call in seconds

dashboardUrl.description: URL to open the call in Phonely

items.description: Array of call objects matching the filter criteria

total.description: Total number of calls matching the filters (not limited by pagination)

limit.description: The limit value used in the request

offset.description: The offset value used in the request

agentId.description: ID of the agent that handled the call

business_phone_number.description: The business phone number used for the call

started_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the call started

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the call ended

recording_url.description: URL to access the call recording

read.description: Whether the call has been read

ab_test_success.description: Whether the A/B test was successful

draft_agent_version.description: Version of draft agent used, if any

draft_agent_id.description: ID of draft agent used, if any

workflow_path_history.description: Array of workflow actions executed during the call

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign associated with the call, if any

numbers.description: Array of phone numbers to add or remove from the block list

added.description: Array of phone numbers that were successfully added

failed.description: Array of numbers that failed to be added and the reason

removed.description: Array of phone numbers that were successfully removed

failed.description: Array of numbers that failed to be removed and the reason

agentId.description: Agent ID (agent should not have a phone number assigned yet)

phoneNumber.description: Phone number to import, includes country code. i.e +10123456789

countryCode.description: Country code of the phone number, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

message.description: Message indicating the result of the operation

id.description: Unique voice ID to use when updating an agent

tags.description: Feature tags associated with the voice

isMultiLingualSupport.description: Whether the voice supports multiple languages

voiceId.description: ID of the voice to assign to the agent

agentName.description: Name of the agent, limited to 50 characters

greetingMessage.description: Greeting message to be used when the agent is called, limited to 500 characters

humanizeConversation.description: Set to true to add natural vocal fillers to the conversation

agentId.description: ID of the agent involved in the call

callId.description: ID of the call being reported

reason.description: Detailed explanation of the issue or feedback

content.description: Extracted document content when stored with the record

contentMD.description: Document content in Markdown when stored with the record

lastUpdatedAt.description: When the document was last updated
When the website was last updated

orgId.description: Organization in which to create the agent

timezone.description: Valid IANA timezone. Defaults to UTC.

prompt.description: Natural-language instructions for the agent and its first flow

agentId.description: Generated agent identifier. Present when status is completed.

workflowId.description: Generated first-flow identifier. Present when status is completed.
